name: 01-new-game
objective: Power on a fresh cartridge and start a new game: press through the title screen, choose NEW GAME, sit through Oak's introduction, pick a name for yourself and for your rival, and end up standing in Red's bedroom with the map header loaded. The name screens offer preset names as menu items, so the keyboard can be avoided entirely; on the keyboard itself A types a letter and START confirms.
evidence: map=0x26 — wCurMap $D35E (atlas, rom+live+inv). REDS_HOUSE_2F is const index 38 in pokered constants/map_constants.asm.

watch:map_width>0 — wCurMapWidth $D369 (atlas, rom+live+inv). LoadSAV sets bit 7 of wCurMapTileset and LoadMapHeader returns without loading anything while it is set, so wCurMap reads the bedroom all through the introduction; a non-zero header width is the cartridge's own 'a map is loaded'. No event flag records the end of the introduction.
